svg.text: (a) split-K:all warps need to write their intermediate results out to shared memory, synchronize, then add up——shared memory 读写拖慢前向 · (b) split-Q:split Q across 4 warps while keeping K and V accessible by all warps——no need for communication(§3.3 原话)
